notes:
What's new in 0.1.122:
- Watching in the browser: the next episode now skips an episode your library does not have and goes on to the next one it does have, instead of stopping on a screen. If a film had to be reloaded in a converted form, the old error box closes once the new picture loads. The M key mutes and the C key turns subtitles on or off, and after you move through a film the subtitle line shows the right words straight away. A film no longer gets an extra jump to the start when the pre-show lets go.
- Music in the browser: Next and Previous wrap around when Repeat all is on, and Previous at the start of the first song restarts it. A song that cannot play now shows a message and the player moves on to the next one (message words added in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Italian). Music search now forgives apostrophes, slashes and full stops.
- Podcasts in the browser: the page plays at the speed you saved, and each show has a speed picker that remembers its own choice (speed words added in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Italian).
- Watch Together in the browser: if the room refuses a chat message, the text you typed is put back so you can send it again. The room panel keeps your typing spot while the room updates, and a room code remembered from another film opens the panel instead of jumping away.
- Live TV: when the first tuner that carries a channel cannot be reached, Beebo tries the next tuner that carries it before it gives up.
- Smaller things: the People page buttons now say whose they are for screen readers (six languages), and the low-downloads notice says 45m instead of 0h 45m.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.121 was published on November 15, 2026.
